## About
Hiro's Transmissions is a transmission shop on Vermont Ave in Gardena. We service almost all types of vehicles, from daily drivers to vintage cars and race builds, and we update every transmission with the latest factory and aftermarket parts available.
We're a member of the Automatic Transmission Rebuilder Association (ATRA) and follow its code of ethics. We promise to diagnose your transmission problem honestly, and we won't pull a transmission out of your car unless it's absolutely necessary.
Give us a call if you have questions. We can probably fix it, and on that rare occasion we can't, we'll point you to someone who can.

## Services
- Transmission rebuild, repair and service: Rebuilds, repairs and service, updated with the latest factory and aftermarket parts available.
- Older vintage vehicles: We work on many of the older vintage vehicles.
- Manual transmission repair: Repair for manual transmissions.
- Manual clutch service and repair: Service and repair for manual clutches.
- Transfer cases: Repair for transfer cases.
- Differential service: Service for differentials.
- High performance and heavy duty transmissions: High performance and heavy duty transmission work.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on older cars?
A: Yes. We service almost all types of vehicles, from the 1920's and up.

Q: Are you connected to the Hiros Transmissions in Lancaster?
A: No. We're the shop on Vermont Ave in Gardena and have no affiliation with Hiros Transmissions in Lancaster, CA.
